meta.title: Reserved and taken usernames refused; live availability moves pristine → validating → success
meta.requirement: AC3 — reserved, case-insensitive unique, live availability
precondition: QA-USER exists (created by API, lowercase name)
steps: Before typing, read the status line (pristine)
Type a free name and read the status immediately and after 3 s
Type the QA-USER's name in UPPER CASE
expected: Pristine: hint text '3–20 letters, numbers, dot or underscore.' shown, no error — UI tree
Free name: 'Checking if the name is free' while validating (seen within 1.5 s of typing, else needs eyes) then '<name> is free' — UI tree
'admin', 'Irbis' and 'OFFICIAL' each: error 'That name is reserved. Pick another one.' — UI tree
Upper-case copy of an existing name: error 'That username is taken.' (case-insensitive) — UI tree

done: 1. Read the status line before typing
4. Type the existing name in upper case
